sourceContext.note: New custom block. Code copied faithfully from the source site's served blocks/care-guide/{care-guide.js,care-guide.css}. Not a Block Collection block. Repeated once per clinical condition (13 instances on this page).

contentPattern.structure: 3 rows: title bar | two-column body (Quick Guide | Referral Guidelines) | Patient Communication footer

behavior: Row 1 becomes a blue title bar and the block id is derived from a slug of the title text (jump-link target). Row 2 becomes a two-column grid (Quick Guide left, Referral Guidelines right). Row 3 becomes a full-width Patient Communication footer. Collapses to a single column below 700px.

suitableFor: structured reference cards with a title, two-column body, and footer
